## Contributing guidelines for The Powder Toy

Thank you for your interest in contributing to TPT. Our GitHub repository is open to bug reports and contributions from community members, we just ask that you follow a few guidelines.

### Discuss with Developers

* For larger PRs, it's important we are aware of your proposed changes in advance. Before opening a pull request for a new element or large changeset, discuss the planned changes with the dev team at [Discord](https://tpt.io/discord) or IRC (#powder-dev at libera.chat).
* Some elements and features may be rejected, and this ensures you don't waste time, or handle the design in a way that we will request changes later. Collaborating with us will significantly increase the speed we review and merge your pull request.

### AI (this i18n fork)

This repository is a **community localization (i18n) fork** of The Powder Toy. Unlike the upstream project, it is developed **with substantial AI/LLM assistance** (GitHub Copilot running on DeepSeek). Every change is drafted by AI and then reviewed, built, and tested by the human maintainer before it is kept; all of it is credited openly in the in-game credits and below.

* AI/LLM assistance is welcome in this fork; contributors just need to clearly disclose which tools they used.
* These relaxed AI rules apply **only to this fork**. Code sent upstream to the official The Powder Toy repository must still follow upstream policy, which does not accept AI-generated code.

Contributions not adhering to these guidelines may be rejected without any explanation.
